title: Private Sunset Cruise around Key West
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
*Visit Stockislandboatcharters.com for alternate availabilities and pricing.* 
Embark on a tour around the island of Key West on our 20 foot pioneer center console. Your guide will be talking you through many points of interest around the island. Make sure to keep an eye out for wildlife throughout the tour. About 20 minutes before the sunset, your captain will find a quiet and private spot to watch the sun drop into the water uninterrupted by other boats, people, or land!
